This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 01-03-2026 (the "Effective Date") by and
between Atlântico Distribuição SA, with its registered office at Avenida da Liberdade 50, Porto ("Party A"), and Lusitana
Ferramentas Lda, with its registered office at Rua Augusta 100, Lisboa ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 12 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in
accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the
purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Switzerland.

Signatures

Party A    Atlântico Distribuição SA / João Silva
Party B    Lusitana Ferramentas Lda / João Silva
